audience_and_mix.story_style: engaging, surprising, conversation-worthy and relatable without exaggeration

stories.title: Amroha SUV crash: two young men killed; reports differ on other details

claims.claim: A speeding Thar/SUV hit a motorcycle on the Naugawan Sadat–Amroha road on the night of 3 November; two young men died. Reports differ on the number of motorcycles and the injury count, so the script states only the overlap.
claims.confidence: two independent reports support the deaths; conflicting details deliberately omitted

claims.claim: A case was registered and police investigation/search for the driver was reported; arrest was not confirmed in the 02:18 IST refresh.
claims.confidence: single local report; no arrest claim used

stories.editorial_caution: No crash footage, gore, victim close-ups or identifying details. The visual is a generic highway photo, explicitly labelled representative; human review required before publication.

stories.title: UP FSDA pre-Diwali crackdown with Bareilly, Moradabad and Muzaffarnagar examples

claims.claim: Between 26 Oct and 3 Nov the UP FSDA drive reportedly inspected 1,133 locations, collected 935 samples, seized 54 quintals of food worth about ₹1.32 crore and suspended 27 licences.
claims.confidence: three news reports; seek fresh official FSDA statement

claims.claim: 32 mobile food-safety squads conducted special operations in Bareilly and Moradabad; local inspection reports described hygiene, expired-ingredient, inedible-colour and rodent-trace issues.
claims.confidence: two reports, both based on officials; distinguish inspection findings from lab-confirmed adulteration

claims.claim: About 220 kg of sweets were destroyed in Muzaffarnagar after flies/insects were found.
claims.confidence: two local reports; Jagran identifies rasgullas, use general wording because descriptions vary

stories.editorial_caution: Do not say all samples failed or all seized food was poisonous; distinguish inspections, seizures, licence action and lab findings. Use a generic sweets photo, not an actual shop or seized product.

stories.title: NCRTC adds 20 Namo Bharat trips on Delhi–Meerut corridor

claims.claim: NCRTC announced 20 additional Namo Bharat trips from 4 November on the Delhi–Meerut corridor.
claims.confidence: official NCRTC notice plus two news reports

claims.claim: Extra services cover the corridor from Sarai Kale Khan to Modipuram.
claims.confidence: two news reports; verify live schedule

stories.editorial_caution: Say 20 additional trips, not 20 new trains; live timings can change.

stories.title: Weak monsoon, rabi sowing and household food-price risk

claims.claim: September 2026 CPI headline retail inflation was 5.54%; food inflation was 7.74%, rural food inflation 8.06% and urban food inflation 7.18%.
claims.confidence: official PIB/MoSPI release

claims.claim: Reuters field reporting says weak soil moisture after a poor monsoon could constrain winter sowing and pressure supplies/prices of wheat, pulses, sugar, onions, milk and poultry.
claims.confidence: Reuters reporting; present as risk/outlook, not guaranteed local price changes

stories.editorial_caution: No claim that all retail prices have already risen by a fixed amount; clearly attribute ethanol estimate.

stories.title: Ethanol blending: food security versus fuel target

claims.claim: Industry participants told Reuters petrol ethanol blending may fall to around 15–17% in the supply year that began in November, rather than the 20% E20 level, because drought constrained maize and sugarcane feedstock.
claims.confidence: 15–17% is an industry estimate reported by Reuters; ChiniMandi is secondary coverage citing Reuters, not an independent primary confirmation.

claims.claim: An earlier oil-marketing-company tender excluded sugar-based feedstocks for the 2026-27 supply year; Reuters reported the tender change on 16 October.
claims.confidence: Reuters tender reporting; describe as procurement policy context, not a formal withdrawal of the E20 target.

stories.editorial_caution: Do not say the government has officially scrapped E20 or that petrol prices must rise.

stories.title: FSSAI energy-drink labelling dispute

claims.claim: FSSAI court filings accuse companies of potentially misleading consumers through the energy-drink label on high-caffeine beverages; companies challenge the regulator's process.
claims.confidence: Reuters reviewed filings; LiveLawBiz covers earlier interim court order

claims.claim: Delhi High Court's earlier interim relief allowed sale of existing labelled stock but not fresh manufacture under that label; further hearing listed for 5 Nov.
claims.confidence: court-order report plus Reuters; hearing outcome unknown at cut-off

stories.editorial_caution: Labelling/legal dispute only; not a final finding of toxicity or a blanket ban on all beverages.

stories.title: CERT-In critical warning on AI-assisted financial cyberattacks

claims.claim: CERT-In advisory CIAD-2026-0058, issued 4 Nov, identifies an active AI-assisted campaign against BFSI entities and names the threat actor CRAFTY FALCON.
claims.confidence: official CERT-In advisory and two news reports

claims.claim: Reported tactics include exploiting exposed systems/payment APIs; I4C suggested transaction limits, beneficiary-name checks and monitoring unusual transaction speeds.
claims.confidence: official advisory for technical threat; Reuters reports customer-facing safeguards

claims.claim: I4C provides the 1930 helpline and cybercrime.gov.in portal for reporting financial cyber fraud.
claims.confidence: official I4C reporting portal

stories.editorial_caution: Advisory is directed at financial institutions; do not imply all bank accounts are compromised.

stories.title: ₹2,814-crore scheme for lithium and nickel processing

claims.claim: The Union Cabinet approved a five-year ₹2,814-crore capital-support scheme for domestic processing of lithium and nickel.
claims.confidence: PM India official release plus Reuters and multiple independent news reports.

claims.claim: The scheme provides a 30% capital subsidy for four plants—two lithium and two nickel—with maximum support caps and milestone-linked disbursement.
claims.confidence: Official PM India release and independent news reports.

stories.editorial_caution: Do not imply the scheme has already produced minerals or reduced battery prices; explain it as a capacity-building programme.

stories.title: Draft drug rules propose immediate suspension after specified quality failures

claims.claim: A draft dated 28 Oct and published 4 Nov proposes immediate suspension of the relevant manufacturing licence after government testing identifies specified not-of-standard-quality failures.
claims.confidence: Reuters plus Gazette Tracker's transcript of draft G.S.R. 956(E)

claims.claim: The proposal requires root-cause analysis and corrective/preventive action, with regulator verification; it would take effect only after final Gazette publication.
claims.confidence: Reuters and draft transcript

stories.editorial_caution: Draft proposal only; do not present as a rule already in force.
stories.hold_reason: Draft only, not in force. Official eGazette PDF URL identified but timed out on retrieval; Reuters and Gazette Tracker transcript corroborate the notification. Human/legal review required before final publication.

stories.title: Supreme Court green-cracker timings for Delhi-NCR

claims.claim: Certified green crackers are permitted in Delhi-NCR only 6–7 am and 8–10 pm on 7 and 8 Nov; complete ban returns 9 Nov.
claims.confidence: PTI report and independent Indian Express/ET coverage of 29 Oct order

claims.claim: Fireworks are prohibited within 300 metres of hospitals, nursing homes, health centres, old-age homes, educational institutions and notified silence zones; barium/non-approved/series crackers are prohibited.
claims.confidence: three reports on court directions

stories.editorial_caution: No implication of unrestricted sale/use; explain certification, dates, time windows and no-cracker zones.

production_checks: Seven India-wide story blocks plus three Western UP stories; no routine job, recruitment or exam items.
Western UP scenes total 213/600 seconds (35.5%); seven India-wide stories total 300 seconds; weather 50 seconds; opening 20 seconds; close 17 seconds.
Amroha narration uses only facts common to two reports; no injury count, arrest claim, crash footage or victim-identifying detail.
FSDA inspection, seizure, licence suspension and laboratory results are clearly distinguished; Muzaffarnagar sweet description kept general because reports differ.
Namo Bharat is described as 20 additional trips, not 20 new trains; live timetable is not stated.
Food inflation figures are official September CPI data; weak-soil-moisture and crop-price impacts are described as risk/outlook.
Ethanol 15–17% is labelled an industry estimate, not a government revision of E20.
Energy-drink matter is a labelling/legal dispute; no toxicity finding or final hearing result is claimed.
AI cyber advisory is directed at financial institutions; consumer precautions are general and do not imply all accounts are compromised.
Critical minerals scheme details checked against PM India official release and independent news reports.
Drug-rule item is a draft, not in force; official eGazette PDF URL identified but timed out when fetched.
Green-cracker order is Delhi-NCR-specific and applies only to certified green crackers during the stated windows.
Fresh IMD West UP warning page issued 5 Nov shows no warning 5–11 Nov; local city forecasts are dated 3 Nov and labelled accordingly.
All visuals must be original or commercially licensed; no news footage, screenshots, publisher photos, social-media clips, music or logos.
Human review remains required for road-safety/crime and fireworks visuals and final Hindi voice pronunciation/pacing; no YouTube publication is authorised.
